source_text: Medicum dicit Dominum Iesum. Non sanos vocat sed peccatores. Herbae legis in schola medici componuntur.
pass_a_gloss: Physician he-calls Lord Jesus. Not healthy he-calls but sinners. Herbs of-law in school of-physician are-compounded.
pass_b_english: Scripture calls the Lord Jesus [[physician >> Bible:Matthew 9:12]]. He calls not the healthy but sinners. The law’s herbs are compounded in the Physician’s school.
